tasks_completed.changes: Inserted 23-line dedup block at line 1072 (before budget calculation). Iterates attractions > shopping > entertainment in priority order. When same name_local appears in multiple categories, keeps only the highest-priority version and removes from lower-priority arrays.

Uses typePriority map: transportation:0, meal:1, attraction:2, shopping:3, entertainment:4, accommodation:5, travel:6. First occurrence (highest priority) wins; later duplicates filtered out.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - data was generated by independent subagents without cross-agent dedup
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Each subagent (attractions, entertainment, shopping) independently categorized POIs. Historic streets like 前门大街 could plausibly be attractions, entertainment, or shopping. Without cross-agent dedup, each agent included what it thought was relevant.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Two-layer defense: (1) Python _merge_day_data dedup ensures merged data has no cross-category duplicates before HTML generation, (2) JavaScript timeline dedup catches any remaining cross-category duplicates in the rendered timeline view.
